units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: в) a media report indicating signs of violations of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 15 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 3) expiry of the period for compliance with a mandatory order previously issued under paragraph 22(2) of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 15 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 4) receipt of a request for approval to conclude a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider);
units.label: Point 4 Part 15 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 5) receipt of a request to enter information on a procurement participant or supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers).
units.label: Point 5 Part 15 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 15.1. A complaint against acts or omissions of the persons specified in paragraph 15(1) of this Article, and information indicating violations of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system in procurement documentation or a request-for-quotations notice, received from an individual who does not satisfy Article 31(1)(1) of this Federal Law in relation to the procurement object and whose rights and lawful interests are not infringed by those acts or omissions or provisions of the documentation or notice, shall be considered by the procurement oversight body under Federal Law No. 59-FZ of 2 May 2006 On the Procedure for Considering Citizens' Appeals in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 15.1 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 16. An unscheduled inspection on the grounds specified in paragraph 15(3) of this Article shall be conducted by the procurement oversight body that issued the mandatory order under paragraph 22(2) of this Article whose compliance is being checked.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 17. Decisions of local self-government bodies of municipal districts, municipal okrugs or urban okrugs authorised to exercise procurement oversight, adopted following scheduled and/or unscheduled inspections, may not contradict decisions of the authorised federal or constituent-entity executive authorities adopted following unscheduled inspections of the same procurement.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 18. A decision of a constituent entity's executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight, adopted following a scheduled and/or unscheduled inspection, may not contradict a decision of the authorised federal executive authority adopted following unscheduled inspections of the same procurement.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 19. When deciding on an unscheduled inspection, the federal executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight shall consider and evaluate arguments in decisions previously adopted by the authorised constituent-entity executive authority or local self-government body of a municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug following scheduled and/or unscheduled inspections of the same planned or ongoing procurement. If those authorised federal, constituent-entity or local bodies, following scheduled and/or unscheduled inspections under paragraph 3 of this Article, have issued decisions concerning the same acts or omissions of oversight subjects in the same procurement, the decision of the authorised federal executive authority shall be implemented.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 20. When deciding on an unscheduled inspection, the constituent entity's executive authority authorised to exercise procurement oversight shall consider and evaluate arguments in decisions previously adopted by the authorised local self-government body of a municipal district, municipal okrug or urban okrug following scheduled and/or unscheduled inspections of the same planned or ongoing procurement. If those authorised constituent-entity or local bodies, following scheduled and/or unscheduled inspections under paragraph 3 of this Article, have issued decisions concerning the same acts or omissions of oversight subjects in the same procurement, the decision of the authorised constituent-entity executive authority shall be implemented.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 21. Information on scheduled and unscheduled inspections by procurement oversight bodies and internal State or municipal financial oversight bodies, their results and the mandatory orders and remedial submissions issued shall be posted in the unified information system and/or the register of complaints, scheduled and unscheduled inspections, decisions and mandatory orders and remedial submissions issued. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve the register's maintenance procedure, including the list of documents and information posted and the time limits for posting them.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 22. If scheduled or unscheduled inspections, or consideration of complaints against acts or omissions of oversight subjects, reveal violations of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, the procurement oversight body may:
units.label: Part 22 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 1) draw up administrative-offence reports concerning violations of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, hear such administrative-offence cases and take measures to prevent them under administrative-offence legislation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 22 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 2) issue binding mandatory orders to remedy those violations under Russian Federation legislation, including cancellation of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection;
units.label: Point 2 Part 22 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 3) bring claims before a court or arbitrazh court to invalidate procurements under the Civil Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 22 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 23. A mandatory order under paragraph 22(2) of this Article to remedy a violation of Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system shall specify the actions the recipient must take to remedy it. A contract may not be concluded before compliance with the mandatory order or remedial submission provided for in this Article.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 24. Within three working days after issuing a mandatory order or remedial submission, the relevant oversight body shall post it in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 24 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 25. On receiving information that a mandatory order issued under paragraph 22(2) of this Article has not been complied with, the relevant oversight body may apply liability measures to the non-compliant person under Russian Federation legislation.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 26. During scheduled and unscheduled inspections, officials of a procurement oversight body may, within their powers and on a reasoned written request, request and obtain documents and information needed for the inspection. On presenting official identification and the head's or deputy heads' administrative order or executive order authorising the inspection, they shall have unhindered access to premises and territories occupied by contracting authorities, specialised organisations and operators of electronic platforms and specialised electronic platforms, to obtain the procurement documents and information needed by the oversight body. Documents and information under this paragraph need not be supplied if posted on the official website under this Federal Law. If documents and information on the official website differ from those prepared during procurement, those on the official website shall prevail.
units.label: Part 26 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 27. Repealed from 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 449-FZ.
units.label: Part 27 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 27.1. When conducting inspections under paragraph 11.2 of this Article, officials of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budget sphere may inspect oversight subjects concerning procurement for which State or municipal financial oversight bodies that are executive authorities or officials of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, or bodies or officials of local administrations, have conducted oversight measures under paragraph 8 of this Article.
units.label: Part 27.1 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 28. At the request of procurement oversight bodies and internal State or municipal financial oversight bodies, oversight subjects shall provide documents, written explanations and procurement information, including procurement information constituting a State secret, and shall also give oral explanations.
units.label: Part 28 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 29. If a scheduled or unscheduled inspection by procurement oversight bodies reveals an act or omission showing signs of a criminal offence, those bodies shall transmit information on it and/or supporting documents to law-enforcement bodies within three working days after discovery.
units.label: Part 29 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 30. State secrets and other information to which access is restricted by federal laws, obtained by oversight bodies in exercising their powers, shall not be disclosed except in cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 30 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 31. Special rules for oversight under paragraph 10 of this Article in the State defence order sphere may be established by Federal Law No. 275-FZ of 29 December 2012 On the State Defence Order.
units.label: Part 31 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 32. The effectiveness of the oversight bodies specified in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be evaluated in the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. That procedure shall provide, in particular, for:
units.label: Part 32 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 1) indicators of control and supervisory activity;
units.label: Point 1 Part 32 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 2) a mechanism for collecting information on those oversight bodies' activities;
units.label: Point 2 Part 32 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 99. Procurement control
units.text: 3) the procedure for analysing control and supervisory indicators and applying the results of that analysis.
units.label: Point 3 Part 32 Art. 99

units.locator: Article 100. Departmental procurement control
units.text: Article 100. Departmental procurement control
units.label: Art. 100

units.locator: Article 100. Departmental procurement control
units.text: State bodies, State Atomic Energy Corporation Rosatom, State Space Corporation Roscosmos, management bodies of State extrabudgetary funds and municipal bodies shall exercise departmental oversight of their subordinate contracting authorities' compliance with Russian Federation legislation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, in the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the local administration respectively.
units.label: Art. 100 · text

units.locator: Article 101. Procurement control exercised by the contracting authority
units.text: Article 101. Procurement control exercised by the contracting authority
units.label: Art. 101

units.locator: Article 101. Procurement control exercised by the contracting authority
units.text: 1. The contracting authority shall oversee the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) compliance with contract terms in accordance with Russian Federation legislation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 101

units.locator: Article 101. Procurement control exercised by the contracting authority
units.text: 2. The contracting authority shall oversee the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) engagement of small enterprises and socially oriented non-profit organisations as subcontractors or co-performers under Article 30(5) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 101

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.label: Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1. Citizens, public associations and associations of legal entities may exercise public oversight of compliance with Russian Federation legislation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, hereinafter public oversight, under this Federal Law. State authorities and local self-government bodies shall ensure that such oversight can be exercised.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2. Public oversight shall aim to implement the principles of the contractual procurement system, promote its development and improvement, prevent and identify violations of Russian Federation legislation and other regulatory legal acts on that system, and inform contracting authorities and procurement oversight bodies of violations found.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3. Public associations and associations of legal entities exercising public oversight may:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1) prepare proposals to improve Russian Federation legislation on the contractual procurement system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2) request information from contracting authorities on procurement and the progress of contract performance;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3) independently monitor procurement and evaluate its efficiency, including evaluation of procurement and contract performance results for compliance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4) apply in their own name to State or municipal bodies for oversight measures under this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 5) apply in their own name to law-enforcement bodies where acts or omissions of a contracting authority, authorised body or institution, specialised organisation, procurement commission or its members, contract service officials or contract managers show signs of a criminal offence;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 6) apply to a court to protect infringed or disputed rights and lawful interests of a group of persons under Russian Federation legislation.
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4. Requests for information on procurement and the progress of contract performance and other submissions by public associations and associations of legal entities shall be considered by contracting authorities under Russian Federation legislation on the procedure for considering citizens' appeals.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 102. Public oversight of compliance with the requirements of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 5. Members of public associations and associations of legal entities shall preserve the confidentiality of information to which access is restricted by federal laws and which becomes known to them through public oversight.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 102

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.label: Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising law-enforcement functions for treasury servicing of execution of budgets of the Russian Federation budget system shall maintain the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities, hereinafter the contract register. Information on contracts concluded under Article 93(1), points 4 and 5, of this Federal Law shall not be entered in the register if those contracts contain State secrets.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 2. The following information and documents shall be entered in the contract register:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 1) the contracting authority's name;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 2) the source of financing;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 3) the method of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 4) the date on which supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results were finalised and the particulars of the document confirming the grounds for contract conclusion;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 5) the date of contract conclusion;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 6) the procurement object, contract price and performance period, including those of a separate performance stage, unit price of goods, work or services, and, for a completed contract, the goods' country of origin or manufacturer information;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 7) the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) name and location if a legal entity, surname, given name, patronymic if any and place of residence if an individual, postal address, and taxpayer identification number or, for a foreign person, its equivalent under the relevant foreign State's legislation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 8) information on contract amendments, specifying the terms amended;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 9) the contract, with attachments if any, concluded under this Federal Law following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures, and a copy of the concluded contract signed with the contracting authority's enhanced electronic signature;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 10) information on performance of the contract or a separate stage, including the value of obligations performed (the contracting authority's payment for goods delivered, work performed and its results, services rendered, and separate stages), assessment of penalties (fines or delay penalties) for a party's improper performance of contractual obligations, and the expert opinion on goods delivered, work performed or services rendered or a separate stage, if the contracting authority engaged experts or expert organisations to examine that stage, goods, work or services;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 11) information on contract termination, specifying the grounds;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 12) the procurement identification code;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 13) information on acceptance of goods delivered, work performed and its results, services rendered and separate performance stages, with the acceptance document attached;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 14) the medical commission decision under Article 24(10)(2)(г), Article 33(1)(1)(г) and Article 93(1)(28) of this Federal Law, with personal data anonymised as required by Russian Federation personal data legislation;
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 103

units.locator: Article 103. Register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities
units.text: 15) other information and documents specified in the contract register maintenance procedure.
units.label: Point 15 Part 2 Art. 103
